glossary.role: Top-secret EFF/Anaheim project that produced GP01-GP04.
Formal name of the lunar state that declared independence from Earth
Common short name of the Unified Empire of Giganos
Giganos Colonel commanding the Gon Jem Squad (the "Filth of Giganos"); pilots the Geyzam, later the prototype Gilgazamune
glossary.personality: Brutal, crude, greedy and cunning, with famously bad table manners; superb pilot; fiercely loyal to his Four Kings

glossary.role: Gundam Development Project Unit 2, RX-78GP02A Gundam "Physalis", the nuclear-armed Gundam stolen by Gato.
YAMA-13 Geyzam, Gon Jem's one-off prototype Metal Armor
Veteran Earth Federation pilot (Captain, 大尉), leader of the Burning Team on the Albion and Kou's mentor; KIA 8 Nov 0083.
glossary.personality: Experienced, strict but fatherly mentor to the young pilots. (The wiki personality section is empty; this is inferred from his role on the wiki.)

glossary.series: Mobile Suit Gundam: Char's Counterattack (also Mobile Suit Gundam, Zeta Gundam)
glossary.role: Earth Federation ace Newtype pilot; in CCA a Londo Bell mobile suit team leader (Captain) aboard the Ra Cailum and pilot of the Nu Gundam; Char's lifelong rival.
glossary.personality: Withdrawn, machine-obsessed teen in the original series; by CCA a mature, dependable veteran still bound up in his rivalry with Char.

glossary.role: Main antagonist of 0083; Zeon ace "Nightmare of Solomon", Delaz Fleet pilot who steals Gundam GP02 and later pilots the Neue Ziel. Rank: Major (U.C. 0083).
glossary.personality: Honorable, idealistic career soldier; charismatic leader who fights on the front line; hates the Federation but respects worthy opponents.

glossary.role: Giganos Captain, the only woman among Gon Jem's Four Kings; Stark Dyne pilot; later joins Meio
glossary.personality: Fierce, violent and battle-hungry; later shows a devoted, gentler side toward Meio

glossary.note: army/MS rank; a ship's captain (艦長) is also Captain
Op 01 uses 'unit' for mecha in general, 'machine' when the speaker is the developer

37.evidence: brief: '私が本艦の艦長、エイパー・シナプスだ。'

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>#c[BE5050]ガンダム２号機#cを取り逃した今、<im(1)>
我々は核の脅威にさらされている。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Now that #c[BE5050]Gundam Unit 2#c has slipped away,<im(1)>
we are exposed to a nuclear threat.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>それだけではない。
ガンダム開発計画が<im(4)>公となれば、#c[5E8FD8]ＵＣＥ#cは
非常に苦しい立場に立たされることになる。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>That is not all.
If the Gundam Development Project becomes public,<im(4)>
the #c[5E8FD8]UCE#c will be placed in a very difficult spot.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>我々は何としても、
#c[BE5050]２号機#cを<im(6)>取り戻さねばならん。
本艦は引き続き、追跡任務を続行する。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>We must recover #c[BE5050]Unit 2#c<im(6)> no matter what.
This ship will continue its pursuit.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>アムロ大尉は、バニング隊長の補佐役として<im(9)>
現場で指揮をとってもらうことになる。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Captain Amuro will take command in the field<im(9)>
as assistant to Captain Burning.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>バニング大尉はアムロ大尉と協力し、<im(10)>
ブリッジから作戦行動と
機動部隊全般を統括してくれ。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>Captain Burning, coordinate with Captain Amuro<im(10)>
from the bridge, overseeing operations and the
mobile weapons forces as a whole.

rows.jp:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>これからも各員、任務にベストを
尽くして欲しい。
rows.en:
<op(37,1)><sp(2)>I expect each of you to continue
giving your best to this mission.
rows.notes: Preserved trailing newline as in source.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>「統一帝国ギガノス」

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　ＵＣＥ諜報部
rows.en:
<sp(0)>"Unified Empire of Giganos"

　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　UCE Intelligence

rows.jp: <sp(0)>#c[BE5050]ギガノス#c軍の最新の動向を報告する。
rows.en: <sp(0)>Reporting the latest activity of #c[BE5050]Giganos#c forces.
rows.notes: Preserved trailing newlines as in source.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)><im(1)>前大戦後に設立された#c[BE5050]統一帝国ギガノス#cが、
地球からの独立を主張して抵抗活動を
続けていることは、周知の事実である。
rows.en:
<sp(0)><im(1)>It is well known that the #c[BE5050]Unified Empire of Giganos#c,
established after the previous war, has continued
resistance claiming independence from Earth.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>さらに先のトリントン基地襲撃事件では、<im(2)>
#c[BE5050]ジオン残党#c勢力との協力による作戦行動が
確認された。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Furthermore, in the recent Torrington Base attack,<im(2)>
joint operations conducted with #c[BE5050]Zeon remnant#c
forces were confirmed.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>宇宙移民の自治権確立を提唱した
#c[BE5050]旧ジオン公国#cと#c[BE5050]ギガノス帝国#cの主張には、<im(3)>
思想的に共通する部分があり、
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Between the #c[BE5050]former Principality of Zeon#c and the
#c[BE5050]Giganos Empire#c, both advocating space colony<im(3)>
autonomy, there are shared ideological tenets,

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>それが、両者が手を結んだことの
背景にあると推測される。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>and this is presumed to be the background behind
the two joining forces.
rows.notes: Preserved trailing newline as in source.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>しかし、この時期にあえて共同作戦を
とることには、別の狙いがあるとも思われ、
引き続き調査を要するだろう。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>However, their conducting a joint operation at this
juncture suggests another motive, and continued
investigation will be necessary.

rows.jp:
<sp(0)>今回の一連の件に関しては
新たな情報が入り次第、
逐次報告していく所存である。
rows.en:
<sp(0)>Regarding this series of incidents,
we intend to report sequentially
as new information becomes available.
